constitution.rule: All proposals require 2/3 supermajority (30/45) to pass
Emergency proposals can fast-track with 80% approval in 5 minutes
Auto-generated proposals must pass confidence threshold of 70% before entering queue
Implementation pipeline has 24-hour SLA for P0-critical proposals
Father Protocol has absolute veto power on any proposal
All self-code modifications must be conference-approved before execution
Skill matrix updates every conference cycle based on member performance
Bridge health checks run every 60 seconds; degraded bridges trigger emergency proposals
Historical learning memory is permanent and cannot be deleted
Conflicting proposals are automatically detected and routed to conflict resolution
Each conference cycle generates a minimum of 3 and maximum of 10 auto-proposals
